sql:
/*
================================================================================
已完成强制引导第 46 步的首日创角用户：引导后最后行为与次日登录。
新加坡仅 fixed_country='新加坡'，不限制 OS；为规避已知引导 Bug，仅取
2026-05-08 21:00 后创角及其引导事件。
================================================================================
*/
WITH TC_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Singapore AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_country' AND tag_value = '新加坡'
),
GuideDim AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(CAST("gamer_guide_id@gamer_guide_id" AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) AS guide_step_id,
        COALESCE(TRY_CAST("gamer_guide_id@gamer_skip" AS INTEGER), 0) AS gamer_skip,
        COALESCE(TRY_CAST("gamer_guide_id@extra_id" AS INTEGER), 0) AS step_order
    FROM ta_dim.dim_13_0_18504
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name, v."#account_id" AS account_id, v."#distinct_id" AS distinct_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND v."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL AND v."#distinct_id" IS NOT NULL AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

    UNION ALL

    SELECT '新加坡全量' AS cohort_name, v."#account_id" AS account_id, v."#distinct_id" AS distinct_id
    FROM ta.v_event_13 v
    INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON v."#user_id" = s.user_id
    LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND v."$part_date" = '2026-05-08'
      AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-08 21:00:00'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL AND v."#distinct_id" IS NOT NULL AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
Guide46 AS (
    SELECT c.cohort_name, c.account_id, MIN(CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)) AS guide46_time
    FROM CohortUsers c
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name, v."#distinct_id" AS distinct_id,
               CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_time,
               CAST(CAST(v.gamer_guide_id AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) AS guide_step_id,
               COALESCE(TRY_CAST(v.gamer_skip AS INTEGER), 0) AS gamer_skip
        FROM ta.v_event_18 v
        LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
        WHERE v."$part_event" = 'gamer_guide' AND v."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
          AND v.gamer_guide_id IS NOT NULL AND b.user_id IS NULL

        UNION ALL

        SELECT '新加坡全量' AS cohort_name, v."#distinct_id" AS distinct_id,
               CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_time,
               CAST(CAST(v.gamer_guide_id AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) AS guide_step_id,
               COALESCE(TRY_CAST(v.gamer_skip AS INTEGER), 0) AS gamer_skip
        FROM ta.v_event_13 v
        INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON v."#user_id" = s.user_id
        LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
        WHERE v."$part_event" = 'gamer_guide' AND v."$part_date" = '2026-05-08'
          AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-08 21:00:00'
          AND v.gamer_guide_id IS NOT NULL AND b.user_id IS NULL
    ) v ON v.cohort_name = c.cohort_name AND v.distinct_id = c.distinct_id
    INNER JOIN GuideDim d ON v.guide_step_id = d.guide_step_id
                         AND v.gamer_skip = d.gamer_skip AND d.step_order = 46
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
LastAfterGuide AS (
    SELECT g.cohort_name, g.account_id,
           MAX_BY(v."#event_name", CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_event_name
    FROM Guide46 g
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name, v."#account_id" AS account_id, v."#event_name", v."#event_time"
        FROM ta.v_event_18 v LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
        WHERE v."$part_date" = '2026-07-29' AND b.user_id IS NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT '新加坡全量' AS cohort_name, v."#account_id" AS account_id, v."#event_name", v."#event_time"
        FROM ta.v_event_13 v INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON v."#user_id" = s.user_id
        LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
        WHERE v."$part_date" = '2026-05-08' AND b.user_id IS NULL
    ) v ON v.cohort_name = g.cohort_name AND v.account_id = g.account_id
        AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP) > g.guide46_time
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
NextDayLogin AS (
    SELECT '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name, v."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'login'
      AND v."$part_date" = CAST(DATE_ADD('day', 1, DATE '2026-07-29') AS VARCHAR) AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '新加坡全量' AS cohort_name, v."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_13 v INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON v."#user_id" = s.user_id
    LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'login' AND v."$part_date" = '2026-05-09' AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    l.cohort_name AS "用户组",
    COALESCE(l.last_event_name, '引导46后无后续行为') AS "引导后最后事件",
    COUNT(*) AS "完成引导玩家数",
    COUNT(n.account_id) AS "D1登录人数",
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(n.account_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "D1留存率(%)"
FROM LastAfterGuide l
LEFT JOIN NextDayLogin n ON l.cohort_name = n.cohort_name AND l.account_id = n.account_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY "用户组", "完成引导玩家数" DESC;
